name: War of Chioggia
title: War of Chioggia
summary: A conflict fought by the Republic of Genoa against the Republic of Venice between 1378 and 1381, the conclusion of an open confrontation that had lasted for years and which had already included some occasional and limited military clashes.
result: Inconclusive, both republics came out of it exhausted, Hungary conquers Dalmatia, Venice forced to pay annual tribute to King of Hungary; Treaty of Turin
